# Alarms
{: .no_toc }

What's firing, what fired, and who gets told.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

This screen is part of the **web Hub's Console** and isn't in the Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS or Android apps yet (specs OPEN-QUESTIONS #27).
{: .note }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `OPS-04` |
| **Route** | `/ops/alarms` |
| **Where** | Operations › Alarms |
| **Who can use it** | operations.view |
| **Kind** | table |
| **Available in** | Web Hub only (Console M3 (web only)) |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rows | table | alarm name, StatusBadge (OK · ALARM · INSUFFICIENT_DATA), since, threshold | firing first |
| History | popover | state changes for one alarm | links to the matching OPS-03 query |
| Subscribers | list | email subscriptions to the alarm topic, with pending confirmations | read-only in v1; changing them is Terraform |

## For developers

Loads: `GET /ops/alarms`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
